name: @bandcoin/contracts
description: Soroban sources (bounty_escrow, nft_oz) and generated TS bindings. Needs Rust and the stellar CLI.

scripts.build:nft_oz: cd nft_oz && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" stellar contract build
scripts.bindings:nft_oz: stellar contract bindings typescript --wasm target/wasm32v1-none/release/nft_oz.wasm --output-dir nft_oz/bindings --overwrite
